record_type: hand-assembled index (an ad-hoc script copied these numbers from results.json and palace_validation*.json); the generated artifacts are */summary.toml, */results.json and */design.json

source.note: generated from a working tree on top of base_commit; the sources are identified by Git blob hash, which the commit containing this file reproduces

quantity: scalar-permittivity electrostatic island capacitance, neutral floating feedline, no junction self-capacitance

primary_run.estimate_method: union, rounded outward to 0.01 fF, of (1) the geometric tail c_last - d_last r/(1-r) at the largest and smallest observed decrement ratio and (2) free-rate least-squares fits c_inf + a n_tets^-alpha on rounds 2.., 3.., 4..; an estimate, not a bound

held_out_refinement_result.statement: The target is reached on the 448k-tet adapted P2 discretization only. Seven held-out refinement rounds of the same geometry lower the capacitance monotonically and it is still falling.
held_out_refinement_result.rigorous: converged capacitance of this polygonal geometry < 89.02 fF (nested conforming spaces, energy minimum; last value rounded up); at least 0.98 % below the anchor (rounded down); no rigorous lower bound
held_out_refinement_result.estimate: converged capacitance about 88.8 to 88.9 fF (computed band 88.77 to 88.91 fF); an estimate with the stated method, not a bound
held_out_refinement_result.one_percent_threshold: not claimed. Rigorous shortfall against the anchor is at least 0.98 %, which does not decide it; the estimate (1.10 to 1.26 % below the anchor) says the threshold is not met. This is an inference from an extrapolation.
held_out_refinement_result.withdrawn_claim: An earlier version ran one held-out round (528,324 tets, -0.264 %) and recorded a pass. That round is round 1 of the series.

cross_solver.meaning: Palace P2 on the exported adapted mesh agrees with GEODE on the same discretization. This is solver agreement; it is not evidence about the discretization error.
cross_solver.palace_amr_limit: Feedline self-capacitance changes 1.90% while island capacitance barely changes; not counted as an island convergence check.

resolution_corrected_run.estimate_method: union, rounded outward to 0.01 fF, of (1) the geometric tail c_last - d_last r/(1-r) at the largest and smallest observed decrement ratio and (2) free-rate least-squares fits c_inf + a n_tets^-alpha on rounds 2.., 3.., 4..; an estimate, not a bound
resolution_corrected_run.label: extrapolation-targeted design, not a continuum certificate
resolution_corrected_run.target_rule: anchor * (primary round-0 value) / (primary geometric-tail midpoint), fixed by the primary run before this run
resolution_corrected_run.rigorous: converged capacitance < 90.08 fF, at most 0.20 % above the anchor (rounded up); the last solved value is above the anchor, so nothing rigorous places the converged value near it
resolution_corrected_run.estimate: band 89.84 to 89.96 fF, which contains the anchor; same method, same mesh family and element order as the primary run, so not an independent confirmation
